sql.value: SELECT fe.account_sets_id AS accountSetsId ,ffas.credit_code AS creditCode,ffas.individual_tax_code AS individualTaxCode, ffas.company_name AS companyName ,fe.id AS id FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax fe JOIN (SELECT account_sets_id, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM fxy_financial_individual_tax WHERE period = :period GROUP BY account_sets_id) m ON m.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id AND m.max_id = fe.id LEFT JOIN fxy_financial_account_sets ffas ON fe.account_sets_id = ffas.id WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas WHERE ffuas.user_id = :userId AND ffuas.account_sets_id = fe.account_sets_id) AND fe.result = 0

select ffas.id AS id, MAX(ffas.company_name) AS companyName, MAX(ffas.individual_tax_code) AS individualTaxCode, MAX(ffas.credit_code) AS creditCode, MAX(ffas.individual_tax_code) AS individualTaxCode from fxy_financial_account_sets ffas left join fxy_financial_user_account_sets ffuas on ffas.id = ffuas.account_sets_id left join fxy_financial_sync_employee_information ffsei on ffuas.account_sets_id = ffsei.account_sets_id where 1=1 and not exists (select 1 from fxy_financial_sync_employee_information a where a.account_sets_id = ffuas.account_sets_id ) and not exists (select 1 from fxy_financial_employee b where b.account_sets_id = ffuas.account_sets_id ) and ffuas.user_id = 801504833780875670 group by ffas.id
